items.en: Can I log an LH ovulation test?
Keep your results in your tracking.
Yes. Logging LH ovulation tests is part of the conception journey.
How do I log intercourse?
A private detail in your journal.
The Intimacy section lets you log intercourse and other related information. This section stays discreet and can be protected separately.
Which contraception methods can I track?
Pill, ring, patch and hormonal treatments.
AWA supports tracking the contraceptive pill, vaginal ring, contraceptive patch, and other hormonal treatments.
Can I set a reminder for my pill?
Set up customizable reminders.
Yes. AWA offers customizable reminders for taking your pill, as well as daily notifications.
Can I log a missed pill?
Keep track of missed doses.
Yes. Tracking missed doses is part of the contraception journey.
Where can I find my intake history?
Review your logged doses and missed pills.
An intake history is available to keep a record of your contraception tracking.
Are predictions still useful while on contraception?
Some methods can change your natural cycle.
AWA can keep showing available tracking information, but how you interpret predictions depends on your situation and method. The app never replaces medical advice.
Is a long cycle treated as "late"?
AWA accounts for irregular cycles.
No. In SOPK/Irregular cycles mode, AWA never automatically treats a long cycle as being "late."
What symptoms can I track with PCOS?
Observe symptoms that change over time.
Tracking includes irregular cycles, acne, hair growth, weight changes and related symptoms.
Can I track acne and hair growth?
Add observations to your PCOS tracking.
Yes. Acne and hair growth are explicitly part of PCOS-adapted tracking.
Can I track my weight changes?
Observe how your weight changes over time.
Yes. Weight tracking is available in PCOS/Irregular cycles mode.
Why do my predictions vary more?
Irregular cycles make estimates less stable.
When cycles are irregular, estimates can naturally change more. AWA uses your personal history without automatically interpreting a long cycle as being late.
What symptoms can I track?
Tracking adapted to the changes of this stage of life.
Tracking includes hot flashes, night sweats, sleep issues, fatigue, mood changes and brain fog, among others.
Can I log my hot flashes?
Observe their frequency over time.
Yes. Hot flashes are one of the symptoms available in Perimenopause/Menopause mode.
Can I track my sleep and fatigue?
Observe sleep issues and fatigue.
Yes. Sleep issues, night sweats and fatigue are all available in this journey.
Can I track a hormonal treatment?
Keep information useful to your tracking.
Yes. You can track hormonal treatments as part of this mode.
Can I log my FSH and estradiol results?
Add certain lab results to your tracking.
Yes. Lab results such as FSH and estradiol can be logged in this mode.
How is my due date calculated?
An estimate shown in your pregnancy tracking.
Pregnancy tracking calculates your estimated due date from the information available in your tracking.
Can I track my pregnancy week by week?
Watch your pregnancy progress week by week.
Yes. AWA offers week-by-week tracking and shows how your pregnancy is progressing.
Can I log my medical appointments?
Keep your important appointments in one place.
Yes. Medical appointments and important exams are part of pregnancy tracking.
Can I get reminders for my exams?
Set up personalized reminders.
Yes. Personalized reminders for appointments and important exams are available.
What can I track during my pregnancy?
Symptoms, weight, mood, sleep and personal information.
Pregnancy tracking can include symptoms you feel, weight, mood, sleep and personal medical information.
How do I track my lochia?
Observe the duration and how discharge evolves.
Postpartum tracking includes the duration of lochia, how the flow evolves, and related symptoms.
How do I track my period returning?
Watch your cycle gradually resume.
AWA tracks your cycle returning, your period resuming, and your hormonal changes after delivery.
Can I track breastfeeding and lactational amenorrhea?
Keep this information in your postpartum journey.
Yes. Breastfeeding and postpartum amenorrhea are part of the available tracking.
What can I track during my recovery?
Fatigue, sleep, mood, pain and physical recovery.
Daily postpartum tracking includes fatigue, sleep, mood, pain and physical recovery, among others.
How does AWA handle nifas?
A religious marker, separate from medical tracking.

When spiritual markers are enabled, AWA can track the duration of postpartum bleeding and show the nifas reference point according to the chosen religious reference. The maximum duration can vary between schools of thought and is never presented as a single universal truth where opinions differ.
How do I track my bleeding?
Watch it evolve, without rushing back into standard tracking.
The After a Miscarriage journey tracks bleeding and how it evolves, in a space adapted to this period.
How do I track my cycle returning?
Resume your tracking at your own pace.
AWA tracks your cycle returning after a miscarriage, letting you gradually pick your history back up without forcing standard period tracking right away.
What symptoms can I log?
Track the physical symptoms you want to note.
Tracking physical symptoms is available in this journey.
Can I keep personal notes?
A personal space in your journal.
Yes. Personal notes are available to accompany you through this period.
Can I switch back to trying to conceive afterward?
Change your objective whenever you want to try again.
Support for resuming conception attempts is built in. Changing your objective stays gradual and is always your own choice.
How does the Hijri calendar work?
Shows the Hijri date alongside the Gregorian date.
When spiritual markers are enabled, AWA can show the Hijri date alongside the Gregorian date and flag important months like Ramadan or Dhul Hijjah.
What does the purity status mean?
A discreet marker related to resuming religious practice.
AWA can show a discreet indicator distinguishing your period from your purity period when spiritual markers are enabled.
How does AWA indicate when prayer resumes?
A marker based on when your period ends.
If purity returns before the current prayer window ends, the app can flag that this prayer becomes due again. Prayers missed during your period are never counted as prayers to make up.
How does tracking fasts to make up work?
Counts days missed due to your period.
AWA can offer a counter for fasting days missed due to your period, particularly during Ramadan, along with a gentle reminder after the month to organize making them up.
How is nifas presented?
A marker that can vary between schools of thought.

AWA can present the chosen religious reference for the maximum duration of nifas, noting differences between schools where the validated content covers them. The app never presents a single figure as absolute truth.
Does AWA give advice on istihada?
Educational content, not a personalized fatwa.

AWA can offer general educational content on istihada and what it means for practice. The app never issues a personalized fatwa, and religious content is meant to be validated by a recognized authority.
What can I log in my journal?
Symptoms, mood, intimacy, sleep and activity.
The Daily journal covers physical symptoms, emotional state, intimacy, sleep, physical activity, and personal notes.
Symptoms, mood, sleep, activity, hydration, period flow and notes.
The Daily journal lets you track physical symptoms, mood, sleep, physical activity, hydration, period flow, and personal notes.
Can my Intimacy section be protected?
A discreet, separate section.
Yes. The Intimacy section can be hidden and protected with its own separate PIN or Face ID.
Can I keep private photos?
To track certain visual changes.
Yes. Secure private photos are available, for example to track how acne, hair growth or skin symptoms evolve.
How does AWA protect my data?
Privacy, security and minimal collection.
AWA is built on minimal data collection, no targeted advertising, no reselling of personal data, and secure storage with real encryption of sensitive data.
Can I export my data?
PDF and CSV exports are supported.
Yes. A PDF export of your tracking and a CSV export of your data are available, so you can build a clear history, including for a healthcare professional.
Can I delete my data easily?
Deletion stays simple and accessible.
Yes. Simplified deletion of your data and account is available from the relevant settings.
